provenance: SKAT:1988qkt (Grabosch et al., Z.Phys.C 41 (1989) 527) — charged-current single-pion production cross sections for nu_mu on the SKAT freon (CF3Br) bubble chamber: nu_mu n -> mu- p pi0, nu_mu n -> mu- n pi+, and nu_mu p -> mu- p pi+ · per nucleon · SECOND-HAND DIGITIZATION: the SKAT points were extracted from the Formaggio-Zeller review compilation (Rev.Mod.Phys. 84 (2012) 1307, Figs 14, 15, 13), which themselves reproduce the SKAT data (originally digitized by that review from the SKAT paper); we did NOT read the SKAT paper's own figures · in each compilation panel the SKAT markers are asterisks overlaid on several other experiments — they were isolated by marker shape (star-template score + fill-fraction cut) and overlay-verified, discarding all other series and the model curve · from the compilation figures
